Data Sourcing Steps:

1. SOURCE DISCOVERY
   MDDL's original home, mddl.org, is defunct (redirects to an unrelated
   content-marketing site as of 2026). The real specification and schema
   files were located via the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine capture
   of the site's downloads page:
     https://web.archive.org/web/20140407001327/http://www.mddl.org/page/resources/Downloads.asp

   That page confirms MDDL 3.0-beta (dated 2007-03-01) is the last
   full specification release FISD/SIIA ever published — there is no
   later beta or final 3.0 release. A supplementary "MDDL for
   databases" schema (mddl4db.xsd) was published in 2009 as a separate,
   narrower artefact (a relational mapping of MDDL, not a new version
   of the core language) and is not part of this download.

2. DOWNLOAD
   Files were fetched directly from the Wayback Machine's stored copy of
   each mddl.org download link, using the `if_` (iframe/raw) rendering
   mode to get the raw file rather than Wayback's UI chrome, e.g.:

     curl -sL "https://web.archive.org/web/20140407001327if_/http://www.mddl.org/mddlFileDownload.asp?file=3.0-beta\mddl-3.0-beta-full.xsd" \
       -o mddl-3.0-beta-full.xsd

   Each downloaded file's sha256 and size are recorded in manifest.json
   for data lineage.

3. SCOPE OF THIS DOWNLOAD
   Only the core specification artefacts needed to document and compare
   MDDL against ORE Studio's own market data identifier schemes were
   downloaded: the full/lite/link XML Schemas, the Technical
   Specification PDF, the release's own license PDF, and the release
   index/changelog text files. The full 3.0-beta release zip also
   contains worked examples (per-asset-class sample XML instances),
   data-model/diagram PDFs, and an XMI export — not downloaded here, as
   they are not needed for the identifier-scheme comparison this
   material supports; see the Wayback snapshot above if deeper coverage
   is ever needed.
